title: § 28-315.6.1 Directional signage at inaccessible building entrances.

blocks.html: The posting of directional signage at inaccessible building entrances in accordance with the retroactive requirements of section 28-313.1 of this code shall be completed on or before August 1, 2013.
blocks.plainText: The posting of directional signage at inaccessible building entrances in accordance with the retroactive requirements of section 28-313.1 of this code shall be completed on or before August 1, 2013.
